label: <DEL> step of length-3 sequences, favored by first token z/e/g/b/j or second token e/c/0/w/u
explanation: Fires only at the delimiter step (t=3) of length-3 sequences: 100% of activations are there, but only about 15% of such steps fire (dev: P=0.145, mass recall 1.0 for phase==1 & L==3). Which of those steps fire depends on token identity in a graded, roughly additive way. The first original token matters most (z, e, g, b, j; z and e first give the top activations, e.g. z z u, e e e). The second token adds on top (e, c, 0, w, u). Sequences with 2+ digits rarely fire. Adding the token sets raises precision to about 0.36 while keeping about 90% of activation mass (dev F1 about 0.50). Requiring both tokens gives P=0.70 but low recall, so the token rule is soft. Never fires during the original or copy phases, or at the delimiter when L>=4.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=1 & out_tok=e (+2.56), phase=1 & out_tok=g (+2.16), t=3 & prev_tok=e (+1.96), t=3 & prev_tok=i (+1.93), t=3 & prev_tok=c (+1.89), phase=1 & out_tok=z (+1.85).
